# UI and accessibility

- UI-004: In a .NET MAUI app, semantic properties are the recommended approach to providing accessibility values; automation properties, the Xamarin.Forms approach, have been superseded by them, and AutomationProperties.Name and HelpText have been deprecated since .NET 8. Description should be set on elements that have a meaning that's important for understanding the content or interacting with the user interface; avoid setting it on a Label, or on an Entry or Editor on Android. Ensure images and icons have alternate text descriptions; support large fonts and high contrast (avoid hardcoding control dimensions and prefer layouts that resize to accommodate larger font sizes, and test color schemes in high-contrast mode); design the visual tree with navigation in mind; don't rely on audio or color cues alone; and test the accessibility features of the app on each platform it targets.
